name: @veilcore/deploy-tools
description: The Vercel CLI that `npm run deploy:prod` runs, pinned to one version with its own lockfile so a deploy never downloads whatever is newest. Not a workspace: its dependency tree stays out of the app's lockfile and audit. Never run `vc upgrade` / `vercel upgrade` with it: 62.2.0 is deprecated upstream for a self-upgrade bug; change the version here, in a reviewed commit, instead. The tar override moves tar past a critical advisory (the version the CLI's own @vercel/fun already pins).
